The Institute of Hotel Management and Catering Technology (IHMCT), Kovalam—an autonomous body functioning under the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India—has released an official notification inviting applications for the post of Lower Division Clerk (LDC). Qualified candidates seeking employment in central government-backed autonomous institutions can apply online through the designated portal.

Overview and Vacancy Details

The recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 2 vacancies for the Lower Division Clerk position. Selected candidates will be placed in the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) pay scale of Level-2, translating to a monthly salary structure ranging from ₹19,900 to ₹63,200.

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

Applicants must review the prescribed educational and age requirements before submitting their forms:

  • Age Limit: Candidates must be between 18 and 28 years of age as of October 1, 2026. Specifically, applicants must have been born between October 2, 1997, and October 1, 2008 (both dates inclusive).
  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a 10+2 or Higher Secondary School qualification, a typing speed of 40 words per minute (W.P.M.), and a working knowledge of computers. A one-year experience in computer applications as of October 1, 2008 / October 1, 2026 is listed as desirable.

Important Dates and Application Process

The online application process opened on October 31, 2026, at 10:00 AM. The final deadline to submit applications online is November 30, 2026, up to 5:00 PM (within 30 days of the advertisement's publication in the Employment News).

Applications must be submitted exclusively via online mode through the Centre for Management Development (CMD) portal at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in. Candidates are required to upload scanned photographs and signatures adhering strictly to the specified size limits (less than 200 kB for photographs and 50 kB for signatures in .JPG format).

Practical Implications and What Readers Can Verify

For prospective applicants, ensuring that all requisite certificates—such as original or provisional educational degrees, category documents (EWS/ESM), and No Objection Certificates (NOC) for government employees—are uploaded correctly is vital, as incomplete or incorrect forms are subject to summary rejection.

  • What is Confirmed: The total number of vacancies (2), pay scale (Level-2), age bracket (18–28 years), application mode (online via CMD Kerala), and the closing date (November 30, 2026) are officially confirmed by the notification source.
  • What is Unknown: The exact dates for the written test, skill test, and final merit list publication have not been predetermined in the primary announcement, as the selection process remains subject to institutional requirements.

Readers can independently verify the complete notification details, annexure formats, and official guidelines directly through the FreeJobAlert Source Article or by visiting the official application portal at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in. A dedicated helpdesk is also accessible on working days (Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM) at 0471-2320101 for technical queries.
